source.author: ov
source.text: Sanctius his animal mentisque capacius altae deerat adhuc et quod dominari in cetera posset.
source.text_original: Sanctius his animal mentisque capacius altae / deerat adhuc et quod dominari in cetera posset.
source.text_english: A holier animal, and one more capable of lofty thought, was still lacking, one that could also rule over the rest.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: Omdius perfecto iam mundo et uniuersis animalibus figuratis hoc addidit: sanctius his animal mentisque capacius altae derat adhuc et quod dominari in cetera posset, natus homo est.
reuse.text_original: Omdius perfecto iam mundo et uniuersis animalibus figuratis hoc addidit: sanctius his animal mentisque capacius altae derat adhuc et quod dominari in cetera posset, natus homo est.
reuse.text_english: When the world had now been completed and all the living creatures fashioned, he added this: there was still lacking, more sacred than these animals and more capable of a lofty mind, and one that could rule over the rest — man was born.
